description.text: Fee Structure Tuition Fee: 15,000 RMB per year Application Fee: 400 RMB Accommodation Fee: 10,000 RMB per year for single room; 5,000 RMB per year for double room Registration Fee: 500 RMB Physical Examination Fee: 350 RMB Residence Permit: 800 RMB per year Medical Insurance: 600 RMB per year Deposit: 500 RMB Living Cost: 600~1,000 RMB per month (just a reference) In Total: 30,350~40,150 RMB per year Internship The internship starts from the last year. Students can choose to do the internship in China or their own countries. If students do the internship in the affiliated hospital of school, students can still live in their dormitory. Before the internship, students who choose to do internship in China need to pass HSK 4.Students don't have to pay for the tuition fee during internship, but 5,000 RMB will be charged as the internship fee. Degree Awarded MBBS Degree: On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the HEUT, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). Career After obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Except this, one can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master’s degree.

duration.text: The MBBS at North China University of Science and Technology is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.The Transcripts of mathematics, physics, chemistry 7.Health certificate

requirements.text: 1.Age:18-30; 2.Healthy international students with valid passport; 3.Graduated from High School; 4.Scores Meet Requirements; 5.Abide by Chinese Laws and School’s Regulations
